hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? AKM arrives in under an hour, any day, any time. No call-out charge.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full system installations, we handle every plumbing and heating need.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, 24/7. We carry common parts and diagnose most faults on the first visit.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Rapid boiler diagnosis and repair with parts in stock. New installations come with a 10-year warranty and full system commissioning.

services.title: Radiator & Heating Faults
services.desc: Bleeding radiators, replacing valves, and fixing cold zones. We'll get your heating back on without unnecessary system overhauls.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: We trace and repair hidden leaks in pipes and joints before they cause structural damage. Pressure testing included.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New tap installations, shower upgrades, and pipe work for fitted kitchens. All work tested and certified.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared using high-pressure jetting. We locate and clear roots and debris without digging up your garden.

about_pullquote: We started this because we were tired of cowboys overcharging good people.
about_para_1: AKM Plumbing & Heating was founded 18 years ago in Wolverhampton with one goal: honest pricing and reliable work. Over nearly two decades, we've completed over 2,500 jobs across the city, from emergency repairs to full heating system installations. Every engineer is Gas Safe Registered and carries full public liability cover.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer the phone quickly, explain the fault in plain English, and don't push unnecessary work. We price fairly and finish on time — most repairs are done the same day you call. That's earned us consistent 4.8-star ratings and a growing list of repeat customers who recommend us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called AKM on a Friday night with a burst pipe flooding the kitchen. Dave arrived within the hour, turned off the water, and had it fixed before midnight. Professional, friendly, and the price was fair. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation from start to finish. Engineers were tidy, explained everything clearly, and the whole job took just over a day. They even tidied up the old pipework. Very impressed. Already recommended them to two mates.
reviews.author: Jasmine K.

reviews.text: Radiator wasn't heating and I thought I'd need the whole system replaced. Turns out it just needed a new valve. Quick fix, reasonable quote, no hard sell. This is how local plumbing should work.
reviews.author: Robert H.
